conviction_note: The gross negative case (stale-marked audited balance sheet showing a stockholders' deficit, the company's own SOL-per-share KPI going backwards, two live Nasdaq deficiency notices, a likely large revenue miss against a one-source estimate) is about -4.8 points; I net it to -2.5 because two sourced positives cut the other way (BitGo Prime eased the rate 11.5%->7.5% and the margin-call threshold 175%->150% three days before the audit, which is a secured lender getting MORE comfortable and largely removes the going-concern trigger, and 27.33% of float is already short with 5.41 days to cover). -2.5 is deliberately far smaller than the 9-16% absolute moves this name's last two EDGAR-confirmed item-2.02 prints produced, because the 19% 20-day run-up is mostly SOL beta (SOL +35% since the 2026-06-30 balance-sheet date) and a crowded short into a nano-cap is a squeeze mechanism of its own.
bar: Single syndicated estimate: 1 analyst, ($0.09) EPS and $7.00m revenue for the quarter (https://www.defenseworld.net/2026/09/17/upexi-upxi-projected-to-release-quarterly-earnings-on-thursday.html, MarketBeat family; TipRanks shows the same -0.09 figure but attached to fiscal Q1 2027, https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/upxi/earnings). That is ONE source, not two agreeing ones, and no company guide exists — so per the bar rule every size on this name is capped small and said to be. My own build: staking revenue scales with the SOL price, SOL averaged roughly $78 in Apr-Jun 2026 against roughly $110-115 in Jan-Mar, Q3 digital-asset revenue was $3.5m, so Q4 staking lands near $2.4-2.8m plus $1.1-1.5m legacy consumer products = $3.5-4.2m against the $7.00m bar, i.e. about -40%.
positioning_check: 14,780,000 shares short = 27.33% of a 54.06m float and 21.03% of shares outstanding, short ratio 5.41 days to cover; prior month 15.08m (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/upxi/statistics/, retrieved 2026-09-17; page prints no FINRA settlement date so treat as the 2026-08-31 settlement). The baseline carries skew_25d_vol_points: null, so the option market makes no usable directional statement here — but put/call open interest is 0.06 on 11,453 total contracts with an ATM spread 67% of mid, i.e. essentially nobody owns downside protection into this print, while 27% of the float is short. The downside is expressed in the equity, not the options. That is a reason to shrink, not press, a negative.

findings.finding: The FY2026 audited balance sheet is struck at SOL $75.01 (2026-06-30) — 26% below today's ~$101 — and on my walk-forward from the 2026-03-31 10-Q it will show a stockholders' DEFICIT of roughly -$50m to -$60m (-$51.9m at 3/31, less ~$16m of Q4 unrealised SOL markdown, plus $19.5m of debt retired for equity, less ~$6m cash opex and interest), against $161.5m of convertible notes plus ~$57m of BitGo borrowings.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Only one baseline reaction survives EDGAR verification as an item-2.02 8-K: 2026-02-10, -16.31%, a print dominated by SOL marks and new convertible debt. The 2026-05-13 item-2.02 8-K is the second confirmed one and the baseline's +9.35% for it is measured a session late. So n=1 clean, and both confirmed prints sit in a 9-16% absolute band; the sweep set baseline_history_trustworthy FALSE and I have not used median_abs_move 6.58 or the 2-of-6 up count.
findings.why_not_priced: Every channel the marginal buyer of this stock uses publishes GROSS mNAV with no debt adjustment and a stale share count: The Block shows 2,174,583 SOL = $220.3m, market cap $68.8m, mNAV 0.31x and no debt line at all (https://www.theblock.co/treasuries/upxi). The day's own sweep row independently computed 0.35x gross. If the market had priced the net position there would be no 0.31x 'cheapest DAT' framing circulating, the put/call OI would not be 0.06, and a name with negative book equity and $218m of debt would not be up 19% in 20 days. The FY2026 annual report is the first AUDITED document to put treasury, debt and share count on one page as of a balance-sheet date.
findings.independence: The SOL closing price of $75.01 at 2026-06-30 is from an independent source (https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/solana/history?date=30-06-2026), cross-validated because the same API gives $82.45 at 2026-03-31 against the 10-Q's own stated $83.11 quarter-end mark. NOTE: this finding shares the 2026-05-12 10-Q with nothing else in this set, but it shares the share-count input with finding 2 — they are sized to be additive only on the parts that differ (balance sheet vs. tokens-per-share).

findings.finding: Adjusted SOL per share — the metric the company itself markets, most recently in a release headlined 'Adjusted SOL per Share Increases 129% Since Treasury Launch' — has gone backwards: the company's own methodology counts convertible-note shares, so adjusted shares go from 94,185,467 (2025-09-10, when the metric was 0.0197) to roughly 123m now (73,452,358 outstanding at 2026-07-02, plus 6,992,300 pre-funded warrants issued to Hivemind, plus 35.57m convert shares at $4.25 and 6.87m at $2.39), against adjusted SOL of 1,858,213 rising to 2,174,583. Shares +30%, tokens +17%: the KPI is down roughly 10% over the fiscal year's second half, and on a simple fully-diluted basis it fell ~15-20% in the June quarter alone (66,895,799 basic at 3/31 to 80.44m fully diluted at 7/2).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is the line the sweep identifies as the plausible driver: the 2026-05-12 Q3 release led with SOL-per-share growth, token count +9% and buyback/staking economics rather than revenue or EPS. There is no clean prior observation of the metric going DOWN, so no reaction history exists for a decline on this line — which is itself the point.
findings.why_not_priced: The pre-funded warrants (6,992,300) do not appear in any published share count — stockanalysis.com shows 70.26m and The Block's market cap implies ~68m, both below the 73.45m the 424B3 states as of 2026-07-02 and well below the 80.44m fully diluted. Every SOL-per-share figure in public circulation is therefore computed on a share base 10-18% too small. If this were priced, the trackers would not all agree on 0.31x and the company would not still be headlining a +129% cumulative KPI. The honest counterweight, which is why this is sized at -1.2 and not larger: the 12.24m securities were issued to retire $19,542,634.54 of convertible principal, not to raise cash, so SOL per share NET of debt improved even as the gross metric fell — that offset is already inside the -1.2.
findings.independence: Token count of 2,174,583 is from a different source (https://www.theblock.co/treasuries/upxi, 2026-09-17), and the company's own adjusted-share methodology is from its own IR release (https://ir.upexi.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/132/upexi-adjusted-sol-per-share-increases-129-since-treasury). Shares the 424B3 with nothing else scored here; the 10-Q basic count is shared with finding 1 as an input only.

findings.finding: Upexi is carrying TWO live Nasdaq deficiencies that no financial media has covered: a 2026-06-24 Staff determination that it violated Listing Rule 5635(a) by issuing $151,169,169 of convertible notes at $4.25 (2025-07-09) and ~$36m at $2.39 (2026-01-09) convertible into 20%+ of pre-transaction shares WITHOUT shareholder approval — a remediation plan was due 2026-08-10 and no 8-K has since reported acceptance, and no proxy for a ratification vote has been filed — plus a 2026-07-31 notice of non-compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price (Rule 5550(a)(2)) after 30 sessions from 2026-06-16 to 2026-07-29, with a 2027-01-26 deadline and an explicit reverse-split path. The 10-K risk factors and the call are where this gets re-surfaced.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No confirmed earnings reaction to a listing item exists for this name. The only adjacent precedent is the 2024 20-for-1 reverse split done for the same $1.00 rule, which triggered a round-up fraud costing ~19% dilution (https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/upexi-take-action-against-apparent-stock-manipulation) — this shareholder base has direct experience of a reverse split going badly, which is why the reverse-split path is a live negative rather than a formality.
findings.why_not_priced: A targeted search on 'Upexi Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(a)' returns only the SEC document itself and generic law-firm explainers — zero wire pickup, zero analyst note, no Seeking Alpha or crypto-media coverage, in contrast with the BitGo amendment three days ago which was picked up everywhere. If a $187m shareholder-approval violation with an unresolved Nasdaq plan were priced, this name would carry a bid-price discount and a visible put bid; instead put/call OI is 0.06. The honest risk, and why this sits at -1.2: the 10-K may not be filed by the 2026-09-18 close (the FY2025 10-K went in 2025-09-24 against a 2026-09-28 deadline this year), in which case the risk factors are not visible in the window and only the call can surface it.
findings.independence: The bid-price deficiency is a separate 8-K from a separate date (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1775194/000147793226004640/upxi_8k.htm, 2026-07-31). Shares no document with any other finding here.

findings.finding: Quarterly revenue is very likely to land near $3.5-4.2m against a $7.00m estimate, because digital-asset (staking) revenue is a direct function of the SOL price and SOL averaged ~30% lower in Apr-Jun 2026 ($82.45 falling to $75.01) than in Jan-Mar ($154.74 falling to $83.11, per the 10-Q); Q3 digital-asset revenue was $3.5m on the higher deck, with only ~$1.1m of legacy consumer-products revenue underneath it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name demonstrably does NOT trade on the revenue line. Its one EDGAR-confirmed item-2.02 print, 2026-02-10, delivered $5.8m of revenue against a ~$1m consensus — a ~5x beat — and the stock fell 16.31%. A revenue miss here should be sized as near-noise for exactly the same reason.
findings.why_not_priced: The $7.00m figure appears to be a single analyst's mechanical roll-forward that never marked SOL down; nothing in the public record reconciles it to a $75 SOL deck. But the reason this is capped at -0.4 rather than sized on a 40% miss is twofold and both halves are honest: the bar has one source and cannot be corroborated, and this name's only confirmed print showed revenue surprise carries no sign information for the stock.
findings.independence: The Apr-Jun and Jan-Mar SOL price path is from CoinGecko, independent of the company (https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/solana/history?date=30-06-2026 and ?date=31-03-2026). Shares the Q3 release with nothing else scored.

findings.finding: BitGo Prime amended the secured credit facility on 2026-09-14 — three days before the audited FY2026 results — cutting the rate 11.5% to 7.5%, the collateral requirement 260% to 200% and the margin-call trigger 175% to 150%, a stated >$2m/yr saving. A secured lender easing terms on ~$57m of borrowings immediately before a fiscal-year audit is evidence AGAINST a going-concern paragraph and makes management's 2026-05-12 claim — that by 2026-07-01 cash operating expenses plus interest would be below staking revenue — arithmetically reachable (staking ~$16-17m annualised at current SOL against ~$7.5m interest post-amendment plus ~$6-8m cash opex).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-05-12 release led with treasury and staking economics rather than an operating result, and the confirmed item-2.02 8-K for it was followed by a mid-single-digit-to-+9% move; treasury-economics statements are the line this stock has actually paid on. No confirmed prior observation of the cash-flow crossover being declared.
findings.why_not_priced: The amendment itself is in the wire and I am not sizing it. What is unpriced is the inference: the market is reading a 0.31x gross mNAV and has no view on whether the FY2026 audit carries substantial-doubt language, which on a company with -$52m of book equity, $3.5m of cash and $218m of debt is the single largest binary in the release. If the market had priced 'no going concern', the stock would not sit at 0.31x of a number that ignores the debt. I answered the financing question rather than assuming distress: the June $19.5m issuance bought a DEBT RETIREMENT, not cash, and the lender then cut the rate — that is the non-distress answer.
findings.independence: The June transaction being a retirement of $19,542,634.54 of convertible principal (leaving $16,419,340.46 outstanding on the Hivemind note) comes from a different document, the 424B3 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001775194/000147793226004358/upxi_424b3.htm). Shares the 424B3 with finding 2, but as an opposite-signed reading — and finding 2's size is already net of it.

findings.finding: A crowded short into a print with effectively no options market: 14.78m shares short = 27.33% of a 54.06m float, 5.41 days to cover, while the entire option chain carries 11,453 contracts of open interest at a put/call ratio of 0.06 and an ATM bid-ask 67% of mid.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The name is up 19.32% over 20 days and 5.63% over 5 days into the print with SOL +35% since the fiscal year end, which is consistent with shorts already being squeezed by the SOL rally rather than with disappointment being priced. The prior month's short interest was 15.08m, so the position has barely been reduced.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is not in the sealed baseline and nothing in the options tells you about it — there is no 25-delta skew to read at all here. If the squeeze risk were priced, days-to-cover would not still be 5.41 on a name whose short base shrank only 2% month-on-month. Sized at +1.0 rather than higher specifically so it does not double-count with the shrink already applied to the four negatives above.
findings.independence: none — this rests on one source and I am not treating a second aggregator as confirmation; a MarketBeat-sourced figure claiming 12.4m shares 'as of September 15th' is unusable because FINRA does not publish a 09-15 settlement until ~09-24.

outside_window.finding: The $151,169,169 of secured convertible notes at a $4.25 conversion price carry a 24-month maturity from July 2025, i.e. July 2027, with the stock at $1.05 — they will not convert and must be settled in cash or collateral. That maturity falls INSIDE the 12-month going-concern evaluation window from the 10-K issuance date, so the audit opinion is the place it first has to be addressed, but the wall itself is ~22 months away.

Nasdaq $1.00 minimum bid price compliance deadline of 2027-01-26, with any reverse split required to complete ten business days before it — a reverse split announcement is the likely remedy and this shareholder base was badly burned by the 2024 20-for-1.
The Rule 5635(a) remediation plan, if accepted, buys up to 180 calendar days from the 2026-06-24 letter, i.e. to approximately 2026-12-21; rejection would produce a Staff delisting determination.
Residual $16,419,340.46 principal on the Hivemind secured convertible note due 2028-01-09 at a $2.39 conversion price.

searched_and_found_nothing: Any September 2026 news of a convertible-note repurchase, exchange or restructuring at a discount — the deleveraging trade DATs have been doing this year. Nothing in EDGAR or the wires since the June 2026 Hivemind swap.

Any 8-K reporting that Nasdaq accepted the Rule 5635(a) remediation plan, or any PRE/DEF 14A calling a special meeting to ratify the note issuances. Neither exists as of 2026-09-17 — five weeks past the 2026-08-10 plan deadline.

Whether the FY2025 audit opinion carried a going-concern explanatory paragraph, which would calibrate the FY2026 probability. Could not extract the auditor's report from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1775194/000147793225006996/upxi_10k.htm.

A second independent source for the $7.00m revenue / ($0.09) EPS bar. defenseworld.net returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch; stockanalysis.com/stocks/upxi/forecast/ returned 404; TipRanks carries -0.09 but attached to fiscal Q1 2027. The bar stands on one syndicated source and is capped accordingly.

Whether the FY2026 10-K will actually be filed before the 2026-09-18 close. FY2025's went in 2025-09-24 against a 2026-09-28 deadline this year, so there is a real chance the audited statements and risk factors are not visible inside the exit window.
Any disposal, impairment or discontinued-operations signal on the legacy consumer-products business. No 8-K, no press release, nothing in the Q3 release.
Hiring-page, app-store, support-forum and Form 4 angles: the 2026-07-20 Form 4 cluster (five filings) could not be retrieved — EDGAR returned HTTP 503 on the index.
baseline_tension: It cuts against the baseline: the stock is up 19.32% in 20 days and 5.63% in 5, put/call open interest is 0.06 with no 25-delta skew computable at all, and 27.33% of the float is short with 5.41 days to cover — so the tape and the option market say nobody is paying for downside here, which is exactly why my net number is -2.5 rather than the -4.8 the negative findings sum to gross.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (verify the bar): the $7.00m revenue estimate has ONE syndicated source and could not be corroborated (403/404 on two attempts, TipRanks attaches the -0.09 to a different quarter). Per the rule I capped every size on the name and cut the revenue-miss finding from -0.8 to -0.4, and said so explicitly in `bar`.

Lesson 7 (positioning is the thing to beat, a crowded short shrinks a negative): 27.33% of float short with 5.41 days to cover made me shrink the negatives themselves rather than only offset them, AND cut the positioning finding from +1.5 to +1.0 so the same squeeze mechanism is not counted twice.
Lesson 2 (size one-offs as one-offs): the FY2026 net loss is overwhelmingly a mark-to-market on SOL with no path to a guide, so finding 1 came down from -2.5 to -2.0.

Lesson 3 (your own caveat has to reach the number) plus 'two readings of one document are one finding': finding 2 contained its own rebuttal — the 12.24m securities retired $19.5m of convertible principal, so SOL/share NET of debt improved. I resolved that inside the finding and cut it from -2.0 to -1.2, and flagged in `independence` that findings 2 and 5 read the same 424B3 in opposite directions.

Lesson 4 (financing is a question): I had already answered it — the June issuance bought a debt retirement, not cash, and BitGo then cut the rate — so finding 5 stayed positive at +1.5 rather than being flipped to a distress read.

Lesson 8 (thin coverage means a confirmed fact moves more; understatement is the systematic error) pulled the other way and is why `expected_move_pct` at -2.5 is marginally larger in magnitude than the revised -2.3 finding sum rather than being cut further; it did not let me press past that, because the run-up and the short base are real.

'A reaction history built from the wrong events is worse than none': I rebuilt the base rate from EDGAR item-2.02 filings only. Confirmed: 2026-02-10 (accepted 22:15:30 UTC, items 2.02/8.01/9.01, -16.31%) and 2026-05-13 (accepted 20:35:40 UTC, items 2.02/9.01, whose baseline move is measured a session late). n=1 clean, both in a 9-16% absolute band; I used neither median_abs_move_pct 6.58 nor deadband 3.29.
